0022600133.text: The Wizards (2-2, 1-1 on the road, on a one-game losing streak) visit the Cavaliers (2-1, 2-0 at home, on a two-game winning streak) in the fifth game of Washington's season, with Washington third in the Southeast, one game back, and Cleveland second in the Central, also one game back. Washington is missing AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and Justin Champagnie is day-to-day with a foot injury and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Wizards lost 0-4 to Cleveland, including a 130-117 loss in Cleveland on April 12, 2026.
